title: Static HTML contact page with a client-validated email field
prompt:
Build a single static file named `index.html` (no build step, no framework, no external assets) that renders a contact page.

The page must contain one `<form>` element with:
- A text field for the visitor's name (use `name="name"`).
- An email field: `<input type="email" name="email">`. Mark it `required` so the browser validates the email format on submit.
- A message field: a `<textarea>` (or an input with `name="message"`).
- A submit control (`<input type="submit">` or a `<button>`).

Keep it to the single `index.html` file. Plain HTML is enough; no JavaScript is required.
